analog.note: The coil is a plain 4 or 8 Ω resistor; amplifier levels are RMS values solved as DC, so power is I² · R. No inductance, no resonance, no frequency response.

power.note: Power above the rated value is reported (warning above 1.25 ×, error above 3 ×); heating and failure are not simulated.

emulates: Whether an amplifier output drives it (sounding, loudness against its rating)
Overpower from a too-loud amplifier or a wrong connection
doesNotEmulate: Sound itself: the browser speaks a DFPlayer clip's words with its own voice
Frequency response, distortion, enclosure acoustics (a sealed back makes it louder and fuller)
testOnRealDevice: Listen to it inside the case: grille holes in front of the cone and a sealed back sound best
Glue or foam-tape it against the grille so it does not buzz
Keep it away from a magnetometer (IMU) and from screws it could pull
